acceptance_commands.summary: Accepted 20 accounts, 75 evidence rows, and 0 baselines as blocked staging.
Projected 20 accounts and 75 sources with no side effects.

builder.logic_impact: None; existing intake and bridge contracts are consumed unchanged.
risks: The 75 source rows use synthetic staging identifiers rather than actual per-record source or post IDs.
Per-row body completeness was assigned distributionally from aggregate counts rather than verified against individual records.
Raw private corpus inputs were intentionally not read.

findings: The 75 evidence rows are aggregate-count placeholders with synthetic local-corpus-staging identifiers and account-level profile URLs, not proposals tied to 75 actual local source records. Replace them with stable body-free source/post identifiers and per-record provenance from a minimized local projection.

bodyComplete is assigned across synthetic rows to reproduce aggregate C/I/U totals. The packet explicitly forbids inferred per-record completeness; each value must come from the matching actual record, otherwise remain null or unknown.

The builder did not run the two exact acceptance commands recorded in the lease; it used npx tsx variants. The corrected commit must run and report the exact npm run patterns:reviewed-evidence-intake and patterns:reviewed-evidence-ledger-bridge commands.
